CREATE TABLE "public"."Recurrence" (
  "amount" numeric(12,2) NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "creditCardId" character varying(36),
  "dayOfMonth" int2,
  "dayOfWeek" int2,
  "destinationFinancialAccountId" character varying(36),
  "endDate" date,
  "id" character varying(36) DEFAULT (cuid2()) NOT NULL,
  "interval" int4 DEFAULT 1 NOT NULL,
  "isActive" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "legacyId" character varying(36),
  "legacySource" character varying(20),
  "materializedThrough" date DEFAULT ((CURRENT_DATE - 1)) NOT NULL,
  "movement" character varying(20) NOT NULL,
  "name" character varying(100) NOT NULL,
  "originFinancialAccountId" character varying(36),
  "startDate" date NOT NULL,
  "storeName" character varying(200),
  "unit" character varying(5) NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "userId" character varying(36) NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT "Recurrence_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."RecurrenceHistory" (
  "changedAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "field" character varying(50) NOT NULL,
  "id" character varying(36) DEFAULT (cuid2()) NOT NULL,
  "newValue" text,
  "oldValue" text,
  "recurrenceId" character varying(36) NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT "RecurrenceHistory_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."RecurrenceOccurrence" (
  "createdAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "date" date NOT NULL,
  "deletedAt" timestamp(3),
  "purchaseId" character varying(36),
  "recurrenceId" character varying(36) NOT NULL,
  "transactionId" character varying(36),
  CONSTRAINT "RecurrenceOccurrence_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("recurrenceId", "date")
)
